name: nano-wallet
description: Create a Nano (XNO) account, derive further accounts, checksum-validate any Nano address, and prove control of an address by signature. Runs entirely in-process: no network call, no custody, no account to open.

skills.name: Validate a Nano address
skills.description: Checksum-verify a nano_ or xrb_ address and return the public key behind it. Returns a reason code instead of throwing. A Nano address that fails its checksum is indistinguishable by eye from one that does not.

skills.name: Create a Nano account
skills.description: Generate a 32-byte seed and its first account inside the calling process. The seed and private key are returned to the caller and transmitted nowhere.
examples: Give me a Nano address I can be paid on, without handing anyone a key.

skills.name: Prove control of an address
skills.description: Sign a challenge with an account's key, proving control of the address without revealing the key or moving funds.
examples: Sign 'unstuck-2026-09-26' with my payout account so the payer can verify it is mine.
